title: Any non-empty X-Impersonation-Token header bypasses authentication; tenant then chosen by request headers
evidence: middleware/auth.go:18-31 accepts header and sets claims{UserID:1} without validation (comment says frontend validated it)
middleware/tenant.go:39-63 falls back to X-Tenant-ID/X-Restaurant-ID when claims lack tenant/restaurant
main.go:600-628,631-641 wrap all protected routes with AuthMiddleware; middleware.ImpersonationMiddleware (impersonation.go:167) is never mounted
suspected_root_cause: Impersonation was implemented as a frontend-validated flow; backend middleware stub trusts header and legacy header-based tenant selection was kept for backward compatibility.
recommended_fix: Remove the header shortcut. Validate impersonation tokens server side (hash lookup via ImpersonationRepository.ValidateToken), derive tenant/user from the session, mount ImpersonationMiddleware before TenantContext, restrict header tenant fallback to public routes only, audit-log impersonated mutations.
required_tests: Garbage X-Impersonation-Token + X-Tenant-ID returns 401 on every protected route (route-table test)
Valid session token yields only its target tenant/user
Token without restaurant_id cannot select tenant via headers

title: POST /auth/login/confirm issues a JWT with only email + tenant_id (no password or proof of prior login)
evidence: auth_usecase.go:202-257 looks up user by email and tenant and calls GenerateToken without credential check
main.go:444 route is public
Login verifies password only against users[0] (auth_usecase.go:131-143)
suspected_root_cause: Two-step multi-tenant login was split without carrying proof of authentication between steps.
recommended_fix: Make /login return a short-lived signed selection token (or session id) bound to email and the verified user ids; require it in /login/confirm; verify password per selected user; rate limit both endpoints.
required_tests: selection token for tenant A cannot select tenant B not in its list

title: Backend never enforces module permissions: WithRequiredPermission only annotates context
evidence: permission.go:15-22 sets required_module_id/required_permission_level; grep finds no reader
main.go:624 permission check commented out
193 wrapWithPermission usages in main.go all effectively auth-only
internal/auth/rbac_manager.go HasPermission not wired
suspected_root_cause: Permission middleware was never completed (Phase 2 use cases commented out) while routes were annotated.
recommended_fix: Implement PermissionMiddleware reading role_permissions for claims user (cached per tenant/user, invalidate on role change), compare with ordered level map, return 403; fix module IDs (SEC-019); deny by default for unannotated tenant routes.
required_tests: Table-driven: each seeded role x each route expects 200/403 per matrix

title: Mock Paymob mode is the default; mock VerifyHMAC always true and webhook is public, allowing forged payments to activate subscriptions
evidence: main.go:197-211 any PAYMOB_MODE except 'live' selects mock; 427-431,583-588 register mock endpoints
paymob_client_mock.go:51-54 VerifyHMAC returns true
docker-compose.prod.yml:74 PAYMOB_MODE defaults to empty; .env.prod.example:24 empty
payment_usecase.go:185-232 only checks amount/currency vs public plan price; initiate returns paymob_order_id to the caller
suspected_root_cause: Fail-open default and no production guard; mock client shares production wiring.
recommended_fix: Fail startup when ENV=production and PAYMOB_MODE!=live or any of API key/HMAC secret/iframe/integration id missing; never register mock routes in production; make mock verify check a configured test secret; default mode must be 'disabled'.
required_tests: Forged webhook in live mode returns 401

title: RBAC administration endpoints lack authorization; revoke is cross-tenant
evidence: main.go:925-947 all /rbac/* use wrapAuthOnly
rbac_permission_handler.go:31-96 AssignPermission only requires claims; any user may grant ADMIN to any role
rbac_user_role_handler.go:34-89 any user may assign any role to any user in tenant including self
rbac_permission_handler.go:107-130 + role_permission_repository.go:139-145 Revoke deletes by role_id,module_id with no tenant filter
suspected_root_cause: Authorization was deferred to the (missing) permission middleware.
recommended_fix: Require ROLES module ADMIN (and prevent self-escalation / last-admin removal); add tenant_id to Revoke query and verify role ownership; audit log changes (permission_audit_logs table exists, migration 104).
required_tests: Cross-tenant revoke returns 404 and row survives
User cannot grant a level above own

title: Unauthenticated order lookup/cancel by sequential id using caller-chosen tenant headers (IDOR, PII exposure)
evidence: main.go:472-484 public order routes need only TenantContextMiddleware (headers)
public_order_handler.go:116-157 GetOrder returns full order incl. customer fields by numeric id
public_order_handler.go:375-430 DELETE cancels any pending order by id without ownership proof
order numbers use unix-time modulo (order_usecase.go:63)
suspected_root_cause: Public tracking designed around guessable identifiers without a per-order secret.
recommended_fix: Issue an unguessable tracking token at order creation; require token (or phone+order number) for lookup/cancel; return a reduced public DTO; resolve tenant from slug/host not headers; rate limit.
required_tests: Order id enumeration without token returns 404
Cancel requires token and allowed status

title: Unauthenticated POST /translations/{language}/upload overwrites global in-memory translations; unsynchronized map write

translation_handler.go:170-205 reads upload with no auth, no size limit, writes h.translations[language] without mutex

recommended_fix: Remove from public router or require super-admin auth; add mutex and request size limit; validate schema; prefer static files.

evidence: main.go:610-616 wrapProtectedWithStatus defined; only use at main.go:681 (GET /tenant/status)
frontend blocks via TenantStatusProvider only

required_tests: Expired tenant can still call /subscription/initiate and /tenant/status
Webhook activation unblocks within cache TTL or immediately

title: No rate limiting or lockout on tenant login, login/confirm, register, forgot-password, token-exchange

auth_usecase.go:40 min password length 6; bcrypt DefaultCost

recommended_fix: Apply per-IP and per-email limits with backoff/lockout (shared store when scaled), raise min length to 8-10, consider bcrypt cost 12, uniform error timing.

title: Seed migration creates a platform super admin with a documented password and no IP whitelist
evidence: 109:5 and 109:10 comment states the password and hash; 109:22-28 ip_whitelist NULL means all IPs allowed; email superadmin@pos-saas.com

recommended_fix: Remove seeded credential; provision via one-time CLI with random password forced to change; require IP whitelist/2FA for super admin; rotate if any environment used it.
required_tests: Fresh DB has no super admin until provisioned
Super admin without whitelist rejected in production

title: JWT secret handling: insecure default, narrow production check, super-admin secret derived from tenant secret
evidence: config.go:64 default 'your-secret-key-change-this'
config.go:69-73 enforces only when ENV == 'production' (runtime_env.go:20-23 also treats 'prod')
main.go:273 super admin secret = JWT_SECRET + '_super_admin'
pkg/jwt/token.go: no iss/aud; algorithm family check accepts HS384/512
docker-compose.yml:90 dev secret committed (development file)

recommended_fix: Require JWT_SECRET (>=32 bytes random) and independent SUPER_ADMIN_JWT_SECRET in every non-test env; use IsProductionMode(); pin HS256 explicitly via WithValidMethods; add iss/aud/jti; support key rotation.
required_tests: Startup fails with default/short/equal secrets (prod and staging)
Tenant token never validates on super-admin routes and vice versa

auth_usecase.go:161,247,317,337-357 token prefixes and user details

title: No tenant session lifecycle: 24h non-revocable JWT, no refresh/logout, forgot-password is a stub, tokens in localStorage
evidence: config.go:65 default expiry 24h
auth_usecase.go:288-305 ForgotPassword does nothing but responds 'Password reset email sent' (auth_handler.go:125)
internal/auth/jwt_manager.go and internal/handlers/auth_api.go (refresh/logout) not wired
TenantSelectorModal.tsx:65, landing authStore.ts:31 localStorage; dashboard authStore.ts:43 non-HttpOnly cookie
password change does not invalidate existing tokens (user_settings_handler.go:306-316)
suspected_root_cause: Auth subsystem partially implemented; legacy managers left unwired.
recommended_fix: Short access token (15m) + rotating refresh (HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie), server-side revocation list or token version in users table, real reset flow with single-use hashed tokens and email, invalidate on password change.

title: Webhook replay/refund-callback can re-activate a refunded subscription; transaction type/flags ignored
evidence: payment_usecase.go:202-205 idempotent skip only for status 'success'
189-252 no use of is_refunded, is_voided, is_capture, has_parent_transaction, type, integration_id

recommended_fix: Reject payloads with is_refunded/is_voided/has_parent_transaction; verify integration_id and transaction type; make refunded/success terminal (UPDATE ... WHERE status IN allowed); store paymob transaction id UNIQUE and dedupe on it; handle refund callbacks explicitly.
required_tests: Replay of success webhook after refund leaves tenant unchanged
Refund callback payload does not activate

used by createAndPostEntry (522-566) for sales, COGS, payroll, supplier, depreciation

Rounding diff <=0.02 posts to rounding account

title: No database-level debit=credit enforcement; balance trigger only recomputes totals; float tolerance
evidence: 137:79-108 validate_journal_balance() does not RAISE; no CHECK total_debit=total_credit; no immutability trigger for posted lines
journal_entry_repo.go:393,730 float64 tolerance 0.009 per entry
suspected_root_cause: Integrity rules live only in Go.
recommended_fix: Add deferred constraint trigger (sum debit = sum credit on commit for posted/post transition), block UPDATE/DELETE of posted lines and entries, use NUMERIC/decimal in Go and exact compare.
required_tests: Direct SQL insert of unbalanced posted entry fails

title: No row locking: concurrent post/void, running-balance updates and number generation race
evidence: journal_entry_repo.go:363-375 status read without FOR UPDATE; 544-596 running_balance read-modify-write per account; 784-798 MAX()+1 numbering; payment_acct_repo.go:563-575 same; grep shows no FOR UPDATE in repositories
suspected_root_cause: Optimistic code paths assume single writer.
recommended_fix: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on entry and account rows (ordered), or compute balances from SUM; use sequences/counter rows per tenant-year; unique constraint retry.
required_tests: Parallel double-post yields one GL set
Parallel posts keep running_balance equal to SUM

Orders-paid total equals sales GL total for period
